description: Find liquidity pools for a token pair across Cetus, DeepBook v2/v3, Turbos and BlueMove v1. Searches both token orders and every Turbos fee tier. Each result reports the pool's own token order. Use get_pool_stats for reserves, fees and prices.

protocol.description: Filter by protocol: 'cetus', 'deepbook', 'turbos', or 'bluemove'. Searches all if omitted.

token_a.description: First token: symbol (e.g. 'SUI') or full coin type

token_b.description: Second token: symbol (e.g. 'USDC') or full coin type

name: find_pools
title: Find pools
